assets.name: Ali al-Zaidi
assets.prompt: Create one polished leader portrait asset for the grand strategy game DOMINION. Recognizable Ali al-Zaidi, Prime Minister of Iraq since May 2026, seated at a diplomatic negotiating table, wearing a dark navy suit, white shirt and muted tie, neutral composed expression. Premium realistic painterly game concept art, clearly an illustration, restrained brushwork, cinematic warm key light, deep teal office shadows, brass architectural accents. Vertical 3:4 composition, waist-up with both hands visible, face centred horizontally at 30% image height, generous headroom so a landscape face crop remains usable. No words, no labels, no interface, no watermarks. This is an in-game character portrait, not a campaign poster.
